title: Skills that earn their keep: one shared A/B engine, and a flow setting changes only when a challenger wins a fair test on real results
description: The agent roster's skill kit (track, analyze, edit with approval, A/B test, learn) merged with the third hard pass, "skills that earn their keep" (2026-11-11): every manager keeps a champion playbook, and a challenger only replaces it after winning a real A/B test. One shared engine in plain code, no model judging numbers. assign(testId, subjectId, arms) is a stable hash split. verdict needs at least 30 sends an arm and a two-proportion z score of at least 1.96 to name a winner; anything less is keep testing, and the why names both arms' counts ("9 replies to 4"). A test runs on one string field of a flow's effective config (an opener, a subject line): champion is today's value. POST/GET /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/tests start and list tests with arms counted from the drafts each arm made; POST .../tests/{id}/promote replaces the champion only when the challenger has won and is otherwise 409. Promotion shows as a card the Owner can watch; the wiki of wins and misses per agent is a later row. Wave 4 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: assign is stable and splits 2000 subjects 40/60 or closer
verdict waits for 30 sends an arm and a z of 1.96: 4 vs 9 of 100 keeps testing, 4 vs 16 of 100 names the challenger
POST tests starts one on a string config field (no session 401, unknown flow 404, bad field 400, second running test 409); promote is 409 until the challenger wins and leaves the config alone
